commonNames.name: Arnhold's Mouse Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

gbif.scientificName: Microcebus arnholdi Louis Jr., Engberg, McGuire, McCormick, Randriamampionona, Ranaivoarisoa, Bailey et al., 2008

wikipedia.extract: Arnhold's mouse lemur or the Montagne d'Ambre mouse lemur (Microcebus arnholdi) is a species of mouse lemur endemic to Madagascar. Its holotype was first collected on 27 November 2005, and was first described in 2008.
wikipedia.title: Arnhold's mouse lemur

commonNames.name: Ayres Black Uakari
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

gbif.scientificName: Cacajao ayresi Boubli, Silva, Amado, Hrbek, Pontual & Farias, 2008

wikipedia.extract: The Aracá uakari (Cacajao ayresi), also known as the Ayres black uakari, is a newly described species of monkey from the northwest Brazilian Amazon. It was found by Jean-Phillipe Boubli of the University of Auckland after following native Yanomamo Indians on their hunts along the Rio Aracá, a northern tributary of the Rio Negro.
wikipedia.title: Aracá uakari

commonNames.name: François’s Langur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: François' langur (Trachypithecus francoisi), also known as Francois' leaf monkey, the Tonkin leaf monkey, or the white side-burned black langur is a species of Old World monkey and the type species of its species group. It is one of the least studied of the species belonging to the Colobinae subfamily.
wikipedia.title: François' langur

wikipedia.extract: Albatrosses, of the biological family Diomedeidae, are large seabirds related to the procellariids, storm petrels, and diving petrels in the order Procellariiformes (the tubenoses). They range widely in the Southern Ocean and the North Pacific.
wikipedia.title: Albatross

wikipedia.extract: The opisthokonts (from Ancient Greek ὀπίσθιος (opísthios) 'rear, posterior' and κοντός (kontós) 'pole, flagellum') are a broad group of eukaryotes, including both the animal and fungus kingdoms. The opisthokonts, previously called the "Fungi/Metazoa group", are generally recognized as a clade.
wikipedia.title: Opisthokont

wikipedia.extract: The family Threskiornithidae includes 35 extant species of large wading birds, and one more that became extinct in historical times. The family has been traditionally classified into two subfamilies, the ibises and the spoonbills; however, recent genetic studies have cast doubt on this arrangement, and have found the spoonbills to be nested within the Old World ibises, and the New World ibises as an early offshoot.
wikipedia.title: Threskiornithidae

wikipedia.extract: The green sea turtle (Chelonia mydas), also known as the green turtle, black sea turtle, and Pacific green turtle, is a species of large sea turtle of the family Cheloniidae. It is the only species in the genus Chelonia.
wikipedia.title: Green sea turtle

wikipedia.extract: Mergus is the genus containing the typical mergansers ( mur-GAN-sərz), fish-eating ducks in the subfamily Anatinae. The common merganser or goosander (Mergus merganser) and red-breasted merganser (M. serrator) have broad ranges in the northern hemisphere.
wikipedia.title: Mergus

wikipedia.extract: Touit is a genus of Neotropical parrots in the family Psittacidae. The genus was introduced by the English zoologist George Robert Gray in 1855 with the scarlet-shouldered parrotlet (Touit huetii) as the type species.
wikipedia.title: Touit

wikipedia.extract: The Canada goose (Branta canadensis) is a large species of goose with a black head and neck, white cheeks, white under its chin, and a brown body. It is native to the Arctic and temperate regions of North America, and it is occasionally found during migration across the Atlantic in northern Europe.
wikipedia.title: Canada goose

wikipedia.extract: The wild boar (Sus scrofa), also known as the wild swine, common wild pig, Eurasian wild pig, or simply wild pig, is a suid native to much of Eurasia and North Africa and has been introduced to the Americas and Oceania. The species is now one of the widest-ranging mammals in the world as well as the most widespread suiform.
wikipedia.title: Wild boar

commonNames.name: Black Hawk-eagle
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The black hawk-eagle (Spizaetus tyrannus), also known as the tyrant hawk-eagle, is a species of eagle found from central Mexico through Central America into the south of Brazil to Colombia, eastern Peru, and as far as northern Argentina. There are two known subspecies, S.t.
wikipedia.title: Black hawk-eagle

wikipedia.extract: The bird genus Balearica (also called the crowned cranes or Balearic cranes) contains two extant species in the crane family Gruidae: the black crowned crane (B. pavonina) and the grey crowned crane (B. regulorum). The species today occur only in Africa, south of the Sahara Desert, and are the only cranes that can nest in trees.
wikipedia.title: Balearica

wikipedia.extract: The asities are a family of birds, Philepittidae, that are endemic to Madagascar. The asities consist of four species in two genera.
wikipedia.title: Asity

wikipedia.extract: Owls are birds from the order Strigiformes (), which includes over 200 species of mostly solitary and nocturnal birds of prey typified by an upright stance, a large, broad head, binocular vision, binaural hearing, sharp talons, and feathers adapted for silent flight. Exceptions include the diurnal northern hawk-owl and the gregarious burrowing owl.
wikipedia.title: Owl

wikipedia.title: Archaeopsittacus

commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

commonNames.name: Hawks' Sportive Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

gbif.scientificName: Lepilemur tymerlachsoni Louis Jr., Engberg, Lei, Geng, Sommer, Randriamampionona, Randriamanana, Zaonarivelo et al., 2006

wikipedia.extract: Hawks' sportive lemur (Lepilemur tymerlachsoni), also known as the Nosy Be sportive lemur or Nosy Be weasel lemur, is a sportive lemur endemic to Madagascar. Like all members of its genus, it is solitary, nocturnal and largely folivorous.
wikipedia.title: Hawks' sportive lemur

commonNames.name: Olalla Brothers’ Titi
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Olalla brothers's titi monkey (Plecturocebus olallae) is a species of titi monkey, a type of New World monkey, endemic to Bolivia. There are between 110 and 150 individuals in the wild.
wikipedia.title: Olalla brothers' titi monkey

gbif.scientificName: Morotopithecus Gebo, MacLatchy, Kityo, Deino, Kingston & Pilbeam, 1997

wikipedia.extract: Morotopithecus is a genus of fossil ape discovered in Miocene-age deposits of Moroto, Uganda. The phylogenetic status of Morotopithecus bishopi is debated to the extent that it challenges established views on the connection between Miocene primates and extant hominids (i.e.
wikipedia.title: Morotopithecus

wikipedia.extract: Sarcophanops is a genus of broadbills (family Eurylaimidae) found in the Philippines.
wikipedia.title: Sarcophanops

wikipedia.extract: Nyanzapithecus is an extinct genus of primate from the Middle Miocene of Maboko Island, Nyanza Province, Kenya. This genus is known from four species.
wikipedia.title: Nyanzapithecus

wikipedia.extract: The Colombian spider monkey (Ateles fusciceps rufiventris) is a subspecies of the black-headed spider monkey, a type of New World monkey, found in Colombia and Panama. The Colombian spider monkey lives in dry forests, humid forests and cloud forests, and can live up to 2,000 to 2,500 metres (6,600 to 8,200 ft) above sea level.
wikipedia.title: Colombian spider monkey

commonNames.name: Venezuelan Brown Capuchin
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The brown weeper capuchin (Cebus brunneus) or Venezuelan brown capuchin is a species of gracile capuchin monkey endemic to Venezuela, although some sources also consider it to occur on Trinidad.
wikipedia.title: Brown weeper capuchin
